observations.dispenser: Ordinary-click deposited the named Efficiency I wooden pickaxe in slot8; Shift-click deposited three cooked beef in slot0. SDK-closed and reopened with both retained. Shift-click recovered the pickaxe and ordinary-click recovered three cooked beef. Tooltip preserved name and Efficiency I; read-only counts restored three total pickaxes and three cooked beef. Native X closed. Redstone dispensing was not tested.
observations.dropper: Ordinary-click deposited three ingots in slot8; Shift-click deposited six stone in slot0. SDK-closed and reopened with both retained. Shift-click withdrew six stone and ordinary-click withdrew three ingots. Read-only player counts six and three; native Escape closed. Redstone dropping was not tested.
observations.brewing: Shift-click routed three water bottles and one blaze powder into their native roles; ordinary-click inserted one nether wart. SDK closure completed while processing. Reopening showed three awkward potions and consumed wart. Shift-click withdrew the first/last bottles and ordinary-click withdrew the middle bottle. Player tooltip confirmed awkward potion and read-only wildcard potion count was three. Native Escape closed. The stand retained its remaining native fuel charge.
observations.beacon_payment: The real one-level iron pyramid enabled first-tier choices. Selected Haste, ordinary-click placed exactly one ingot and confirmed payment. Player ingot count decreased from three to two and the Haste icon appeared in the HUD. The screen stayed open after confirmation; native inventory key closed it. Reopening retained the selected Haste choice.
observations.beacon_close_failure: Placed one of the remaining two ingots as an unused payment and requested SDK closure at06:44:03. Closure did not complete; the five-second quarantine disconnected the tester at06:44:08. The immediate pre-disconnect player count was one. Rejoin recovered the unused payment, restoring exactly two ingots. This is a failed SDK-close test, not successful closure or crash qualification.
observations.crafter_control: Clicked empty slots0 and8 to disable them. SDK close at06:48:45 did not complete and triggered the five-second quarantine at06:48:50. Rejoin/reopen retained both disabled edge slots. Re-enabled slot0, ordinary-click deposited one oak log and observed a four-plank recipe preview with slot8 still disabled. No cancellation or immediate denial occurred during the normal toggle inputs.
observations.crafter_output: Read-only initial oak-plank count was zero. Placed a redstone block with keep in adjacent air. The log was consumed and four oak planks reached the nearby player through native world output/pickup; screenshot and read-only count confirmed four. Native Escape closed normally. Verified and removed only the temporary redstone trigger.
observations.wrong_source: Requested crafter against the nearby brewing stand. Refused before opening with one expected denial and no ticket leak.
observations.form_regression: One SDK form action callback; zero outstanding form tickets.

counter_limit: Two opens each for dispenser, dropper, brewing, beacon and crafter. Eight normal closes, two failed SDK closes ending in disconnect quarantine, and one wrong-family refusal before opening. Later diagnostic runs must retain their separate identities and private-probe status.

A give command after the beacon disconnect failed with no matching player and was repeated only after confirmed reconnect. Read-only clear always specified maxCount0. A console wait used the wrong expected closure text once; the log confirms the close command executed once and completed normally for brewing.
